name: commissioning an office
from: Work that somebody answers for only informally, and an org chart that accumulates offices nobody has ended.
to: An office seated when there is work nobody answers for — named, recorded what it is for, seated under a superior, given its reciprocal edge — and an office decommissioned when it answers for nothing: edges retracted, marked retired, where its work went recorded. The second motion is the one that gets skipped, and skipping it is what makes an org chart lie: a commission with no end is not a commission, it is an accumulation.
cost: The drafting of the commission, the execution against the record, and the answering for the record being correct afterward.
otherwise: The roster only advances when emsenn also does the filing, the reciprocal edges, and the check by hand — emsenn stays the executive function. An office exists when the record says so and the graph agrees; an office nobody presides over is a claim, not a seat.
